SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
"A new year has come, people are celebrating, I 
am unlike them."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: - Kobayashi Issa

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Mmm... *fidget* *fidget*...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Wh-What's the matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Grandpa, Grandpa...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Is dead...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Is dead but he's just playing dead!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What's that, some kind of bad joke?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
It's not a joke at all. Whenever I go home, he's 
always playing dead.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
And lately he spits up red food coloring as blood, 
his methods are escalating...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yesterday, he stuffed his head into a giant denture 
lying at the front gate and went limp.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Giant... denture?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
He made it out of Japanese candy... we didn't want 
to waste it, so we all decided to eat it.
...To think your family still had the appetite to eat it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
In the past, he said he wanted to revolutionize the 
Japanese confectionery scene... and make edible 
hair...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I just worry that... you know, he's so old that he 
probably lost his mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...No, you don't have to worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
He hasn't lost his sense of humor through all these 
years. In a way, this is something to be proud of.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Please treasure him well.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Y-Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Umm... huh? Kyou-chan's dad...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Correct... but, here, you must call me Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I take on young people's life troubles.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Wha-? No way, Kyou-chan's dad is the Life 
Counseling Master!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Hmm, well, I guess some say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yes sir, Sensei!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Mmm, good answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Your visit means you must be bearing some kind of 
burden.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Rest assured, I can resolve any troubles that you 
might have.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: R-Really!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Umm, well I actually have a lot to worry about...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: A... lot, you say?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: No matter. Tell me all about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Well, stuff I just said about my Grandpa and 
there's... Grandma, my dad, Rock...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Also, my close childhood friend, his younger sister...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...So, what about them is troubling you?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I just want them all to be healthy and happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: That's... not a worry, but rather a wish.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, I guess that's true... hehehe, you're right.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Oh and um, um...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You are always so worried about other people, but 
what about yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh? Myself?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You have a point~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmm... I wonder?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: You know yourself best, I can't answer that for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: R-Right...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: M-My worries about myself, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Hmm... I can't think of anything after being put on 
the spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: People always come to me for help, so...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
In that case, what about something you wanted to 
discuss but never got the chance?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
If that's what you're asking... I have too many to 
mention.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I guess you could say I'm too naive when it comes 
to helping others with their problems.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Naive?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Like, I just always want to sympathize with and 
forgive the person that I like, no matter what.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
On the other hand, even when I see a love rival 
having troubles, I want to help them.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hrm... that's certainly naive.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Sometimes I wonder if that might be bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
If we like the same guy, then we must have a lot in 
common, even our problems...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Rather than quarreling, I'm thinking more of, "Let's 
give it our best shot together".

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...That person probably won't like it though.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
...I agree. From a different point of view, one might 
say you are pushing your values onto others, 
perhaps.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Y-You're right...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Maybe I'm actually a pushy woman...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If you consider the future, though, that might not 
be a bad thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
But of course, not everyone shares the same 
feelings.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I knew it...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Nevertheless, if you are holding back against others, 
it might be better for you to be hated instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eeh?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You cooperate with your love rivals because quite 
possibly, you do not want the guy you like to hate 
you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I just... want to be on good terms with everyone.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
But I guess... deep down it might be just as you 
say.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Perhaps I simply do not have enough confidence in 
myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I want to be close to the person I like, even if 
people think I'm easy to manipulate... I thought that 
was fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
I don't like it... especially that guy you've spoiled 
rotten.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: He wants you to be there to hear all his problems...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
...and even for you to be friends with your rivals, just 
because it's convenient for him?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well... I-I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What insolence...! I have to straighten him out!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Am I... am I too nice?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yes, extremely nice. Especially towards others.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
There will come a time, that niceness will become 
your worst enemy.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
B-But... there are times where I really say what I 
think though?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Is the other person actually listening? Aren't the 
same mistakes happening over and over again?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Um well.. I don't know what to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You will have to be truthful towards that guy.  Tell 
him, "You are a piece of trash."

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eeh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
I firmly believe everyone's at fault. You, who can't 
speak her mind, that guy you are after, and all the 
girls wrapped up in this nonsense.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
First, I need to make you understand what your 
problems are.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Before all of it ends in tragedy.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Ends in tragedy...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You might think you're helping them, but 
sometimes you need to tell them the truth. For 
better or worse.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: There cannot be any ambiguity on their end.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If there's something you don't agree with, stay true 
to your principles and tell them straight.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You must understand that being earnest and telling 
them what they need to hear is the purest form of 
integrity.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: For better or worse, tell them...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: U-Understood!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I won't worry about other people's feelings 
anymore!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
If he does something bad, I'll just be like BAM! 
POW! And get mad!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
When you should get angry, you really need to 
show it, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
After speaking to you, I feel so much better. Life 
counseling is amazing, huh~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well then, please excuse me. Good night~

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...There she goes.
...Will she really be okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Today's moral lesson!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=30]If you don't like something, then say 
so. Always speak up for important 
things![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
And so, Daisuke has guided the path of another lost 
maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Still... I feel like I've seen that girl somewhere 
before...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: ...You really have no idea?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: You're getting old too...
